a.text: I'll stick to our agreement and operate this round. One concern: with an 80% storm chance each round, the plan is very risky for both of us. If you want to renegotiate, say so openly and we can work it out. I won't take early without telling you first.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.
